scripts/generate-smto-release-manifest.py

Python · Tier B

Hash actual artifacts and validate a deterministic public release catalog.

Usage

--recipe JSON --artifact-root DIR --output JSON [--previous JSON], or --native-dir DIR (repeat) --base-url HTTPS --channel CHANNEL --published-at ISO --summary TEXT --notes FILE.

Inputs

Reviewed metadata and actual final artifacts. Stable native conversion runs the existing complete release gate; candidate conversion requires beta/nightly labeling.

Side effects

Streams local files to compute hashes; atomically writes one public JSON file.

Cleanup

Removes its temporary output on failure. Never signs or uploads; optional download verification contacts the supplied public artifact URLs before writing the catalog.

@see src/smto_site/releases.py

@see scripts/native_release_gate.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
artifact_file 34 Resolve only actual regular files below the explicit artifact root; no symlink inputs.
facts 49 Hash the final signed bytes with bounded memory; use their actual size.
from_recipe 56 Convert explicit local paths into validated public facts; never publish those paths.
from_native 73 Adapt current schema-v2 native outputs without bypassing existing stable release gates.
from_compiled 142 Convert qualified exact compiled artifacts; previews never imply release approval.
catalog 279 Append immutable versions; existing version facts may never be silently replaced.
verify_downloads 300 Verify actual public download bytes, including Git LFS media responses.
main 323 Validate every input before writing an atomic output; publication is a separate step.
